## Built-in structural syntax

### `<All>`

Run tasks in parallel. `<All><Spawn>first</Spawn><Spawn>second</Spawn></All>` expands every task at the same time, waits for them all to succeed, and preserves their Markdown order. Write at least two `<Spawn>` children directly inside it; if one fails, unfinished tasks are cancelled and `<All>` produces no output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<All><Spawn>…</Spawn><Spawn>…</Spawn></All>
```

**Body context:** The `<Spawn>` children this runs at the same time.

### `<Answer>`

Supply one answer inside `<Answers>`. `<Answer template="Approve {?what}?" value={{ ok: true }} />` answers any elicitation its template matches — `{?name}` matches any text. The first matching `<Answer>` wins.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answer template="text" value={value} />
<Answer value={value}>…</Answer>
```

**Body context:** A multiline template, in place of the single-line `template` prop.

### `<Answers>`

Answer any `<Elicit>` in its content without asking a person. `<Answers>…</Answers>` replies from the `<Answer>` matchers declared inside it, reaching elicitations from nested components too. `delegate` passes an unmatched one outward instead of failing.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answers>…</Answers>
```

**Body context:** `<Answer>` matchers, and the body they answer for.

### `<Break>`

Exit the nearest enclosing `<Loop>`. `<Break />` stops the current iteration where it is; nothing after it in that iteration runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Break />
```

### `<Case>`

Define one branch of a `<Switch>`. `<Case value="ready">…</Case>` matches with `===`; `<Case default>…</Case>` is the final fallback.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Case value={value}>…</Case>
<Case default>…</Case>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded when this case is selected.

### `<Catch>`

Handle a failure in the preceding Try body. `<Catch as="error">{error.message}</Catch>` runs after clean release; its bindings stay local. Cancellation skips this branch.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Catch as="error">…</Catch>
<Catch>…</Catch>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Binds the ordinary Error by reference in this branch.

**Body context:** Recovery content.

### `<Content>`

Render what the caller wrote inside this component. `<Content />` renders all of it; `<Content slot="footer" />` renders just the part the caller marked `slot="footer"`.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Content />
<Content slot="name" />
```

### `<Each>`

Repeat content for each item in an array. `<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>` binds each one to `item` inside.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Captures the whole rendered loop instead of emitting it.

**Body context:** Markdown rendered once per element.

### `<Else>`

The branch `<If>` takes when its condition is false. `<Else>…</Else>` is written directly inside an `<If>`, and is an error anywhere else.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Else>…</Else>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the enclosing condition does not hold.

### `<Finally>`

Finish a Try after its attempted body and recovery. `<Finally>Cleanup.</Finally>` also runs and joins on terminal Stop. Resumable Exit leaves an unentered branch pending; failed release and infrastructure failure prevent new entry.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Finally>…</Finally>
```

**Body context:** Completion content using the surrounding bindings.

### `<If>`

Expand content only when a condition is true. `<If condition={ready}>…</If>` expands its content, or the `<Else>` branch instead. The branch not taken never runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<If condition={condition}>…</If>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the condition holds, up to an `<Else>`.

### `<Let>`

Bind a name for the rest of the region. `<Let as="plan">…</Let>` binds what its content rendered; `<Let as="plan" value={result} />` binds the value. `select` narrows the rendered content to one CSS selection.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Let as="name">…</Let>
<Let as="name" value={value} />
```

**`as`:** Required. The binding name the value is available under.

**Body context:** Markdown whose rendered text becomes the binding, in the paired form.

### `<Loop>`

Repeat content up to `max` times. `<Loop max={5}>…</Loop>` expands its content again and again until a `<Break>` inside it, or until `max` is reached. `max` is required.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Loop max={count}>…</Loop>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded once per iteration.

### `<Output>`

Restrict what a document or component renders. `<Output>…</Output>` becomes its entire output; anything outside the region is not rendered.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Output>…</Output>
```

**Body context:** The rendered output the run presents.

### `<PrintErrors>`

Convert thrown errors into output without failing. `<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>` renders any failure inside it as part of the output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>
```

**Body context:** The region whose failures are printed rather than raised.

### `<Return>`

Return a value instead of rendered markdown. `<Return value={result} />` hands the value to the caller, checked against the component's declared `returns` schema.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Return value={value} />
```

### `<Spawn>`

Run a task in parallel inside of `<All>`. Write `<Spawn>…</Spawn>` directly inside `<All>`; bindings made in its content stay with that task, and `<Return>` or `<Break>` cannot affect work outside it.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Spawn>…</Spawn>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded in its own child, beside its siblings.

### `<Switch>`

Choose one branch by comparing a value with `===`. `<Switch value={status}><Case value="ready">…</Case><Case default>…</Case></Switch>` expands the first matching case, or the final default when none matches.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Switch value={value}>…</Switch>
```

**Body context:** Direct `<Case>` branches considered in source order.

### `<Try>`

Recover an ordinary failure after its resources close. `<Try>…<Catch>fallback</Catch></Try>` keeps the rendered prefix and stops the attempted body at failure. Write Catch, Finally, or both. Failed release and infrastructure failures end execution.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Try>…<Catch>…</Catch><Finally>…</Finally></Try>
```

**Body context:** Attempted content followed by direct Catch and Finally branches.

## Built-in components

### `<CodeBlock>`

Show arbitrary text as a fenced Markdown code block. `<CodeBlock value={source} language="markdown" />` chooses a fence the value cannot close.

**Forms:** `<CodeBlock />`

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | yes |  |
| `language` | `string` | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "value": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+#-]*$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "value"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

**`as`:** Optional. Captures the exact fenced Markdown instead of emitting it.

**Returns:** text — the markdown this component renders.

```json
{
  "type": "string"
}
```

**Origin:** `@executablemd/core` (registered default)

### `<Evaluate>`

Evaluate program text. `<Evaluate text={program} allow={["read"]} />` runs it.

**Forms:** `<Evaluate />`, `<Evaluate>…</Evaluate>`

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | no | The program to evaluate, for the self-closing form. Written instead of content, never beside it. |
| `allow` | `array` | no | Optional. Which effect classes the program may draw on, narrowing what this host already installed. Omitted asks for `read`. |

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The program to evaluate, for the self-closing form. Written instead of content, never beside it."
    },
    "allow": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "read",
          "write"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Optional. Which effect classes the program may draw on, narrowing what this host already installed. Omitted asks for `read`."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

**`as`:** Optional. Captures the fragment's rendered output instead of emitting it.

**Returns:** text — the markdown this component renders.

```json
{
  "type": "string"
}
```

**Origin:** `@executablemd/core` (protected component)

## Built-in structural syntax

### `<All>`

Run tasks in parallel. `<All><Spawn>first</Spawn><Spawn>second</Spawn></All>` expands every task at the same time, waits for them all to succeed, and preserves their Markdown order. Write at least two `<Spawn>` children directly inside it; if one fails, unfinished tasks are cancelled and `<All>` produces no output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<All><Spawn>…</Spawn><Spawn>…</Spawn></All>
```

**Body context:** The `<Spawn>` children this runs at the same time.

### `<Answer>`

Supply one answer inside `<Answers>`. `<Answer template="Approve {?what}?" value={{ ok: true }} />` answers any elicitation its template matches — `{?name}` matches any text. The first matching `<Answer>` wins.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answer template="text" value={value} />
<Answer value={value}>…</Answer>
```

**Body context:** A multiline template, in place of the single-line `template` prop.

### `<Answers>`

Answer any `<Elicit>` in its content without asking a person. `<Answers>…</Answers>` replies from the `<Answer>` matchers declared inside it, reaching elicitations from nested components too. `delegate` passes an unmatched one outward instead of failing.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answers>…</Answers>
```

**Body context:** `<Answer>` matchers, and the body they answer for.

### `<Break>`

Exit the nearest enclosing `<Loop>`. `<Break />` stops the current iteration where it is; nothing after it in that iteration runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Break />
```

### `<Case>`

Define one branch of a `<Switch>`. `<Case value="ready">…</Case>` matches with `===`; `<Case default>…</Case>` is the final fallback.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Case value={value}>…</Case>
<Case default>…</Case>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded when this case is selected.

### `<Catch>`

Handle a failure in the preceding Try body. `<Catch as="error">{error.message}</Catch>` runs after clean release; its bindings stay local. Cancellation skips this branch.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Catch as="error">…</Catch>
<Catch>…</Catch>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Binds the ordinary Error by reference in this branch.

**Body context:** Recovery content.

### `<Content>`

Render what the caller wrote inside this component. `<Content />` renders all of it; `<Content slot="footer" />` renders just the part the caller marked `slot="footer"`.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Content />
<Content slot="name" />
```

### `<Each>`

Repeat content for each item in an array. `<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>` binds each one to `item` inside.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Captures the whole rendered loop instead of emitting it.

**Body context:** Markdown rendered once per element.

### `<Else>`

The branch `<If>` takes when its condition is false. `<Else>…</Else>` is written directly inside an `<If>`, and is an error anywhere else.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Else>…</Else>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the enclosing condition does not hold.

### `<Finally>`

Finish a Try after its attempted body and recovery. `<Finally>Cleanup.</Finally>` also runs and joins on terminal Stop. Resumable Exit leaves an unentered branch pending; failed release and infrastructure failure prevent new entry.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Finally>…</Finally>
```

**Body context:** Completion content using the surrounding bindings.

### `<If>`

Expand content only when a condition is true. `<If condition={ready}>…</If>` expands its content, or the `<Else>` branch instead. The branch not taken never runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<If condition={condition}>…</If>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the condition holds, up to an `<Else>`.

### `<Let>`

Bind a name for the rest of the region. `<Let as="plan">…</Let>` binds what its content rendered; `<Let as="plan" value={result} />` binds the value. `select` narrows the rendered content to one CSS selection.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Let as="name">…</Let>
<Let as="name" value={value} />
```

**`as`:** Required. The binding name the value is available under.

**Body context:** Markdown whose rendered text becomes the binding, in the paired form.

### `<Loop>`

Repeat content up to `max` times. `<Loop max={5}>…</Loop>` expands its content again and again until a `<Break>` inside it, or until `max` is reached. `max` is required.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Loop max={count}>…</Loop>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded once per iteration.

### `<Output>`

Restrict what a document or component renders. `<Output>…</Output>` becomes its entire output; anything outside the region is not rendered.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Output>…</Output>
```

**Body context:** The rendered output the run presents.

### `<PrintErrors>`

Convert thrown errors into output without failing. `<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>` renders any failure inside it as part of the output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>
```

**Body context:** The region whose failures are printed rather than raised.

### `<Return>`

Return a value instead of rendered markdown. `<Return value={result} />` hands the value to the caller, checked against the component's declared `returns` schema.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Return value={value} />
```

### `<Spawn>`

Run a task in parallel inside of `<All>`. Write `<Spawn>…</Spawn>` directly inside `<All>`; bindings made in its content stay with that task, and `<Return>` or `<Break>` cannot affect work outside it.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Spawn>…</Spawn>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded in its own child, beside its siblings.

### `<Switch>`

Choose one branch by comparing a value with `===`. `<Switch value={status}><Case value="ready">…</Case><Case default>…</Case></Switch>` expands the first matching case, or the final default when none matches.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Switch value={value}>…</Switch>
```

**Body context:** Direct `<Case>` branches considered in source order.

### `<Try>`

Recover an ordinary failure after its resources close. `<Try>…<Catch>fallback</Catch></Try>` keeps the rendered prefix and stops the attempted body at failure. Write Catch, Finally, or both. Failed release and infrastructure failures end execution.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Try>…<Catch>…</Catch><Finally>…</Finally></Try>
```

**Body context:** Attempted content followed by direct Catch and Finally branches.

## Built-in structural syntax

### `<All>`

Run tasks in parallel. `<All><Spawn>first</Spawn><Spawn>second</Spawn></All>` expands every task at the same time, waits for them all to succeed, and preserves their Markdown order. Write at least two `<Spawn>` children directly inside it; if one fails, unfinished tasks are cancelled and `<All>` produces no output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<All><Spawn>…</Spawn><Spawn>…</Spawn></All>
```

**Body context:** The `<Spawn>` children this runs at the same time.

### `<Answer>`

Supply one answer inside `<Answers>`. `<Answer template="Approve {?what}?" value={{ ok: true }} />` answers any elicitation its template matches — `{?name}` matches any text. The first matching `<Answer>` wins.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answer template="text" value={value} />
<Answer value={value}>…</Answer>
```

**Body context:** A multiline template, in place of the single-line `template` prop.

### `<Answers>`

Answer any `<Elicit>` in its content without asking a person. `<Answers>…</Answers>` replies from the `<Answer>` matchers declared inside it, reaching elicitations from nested components too. `delegate` passes an unmatched one outward instead of failing.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Answers>…</Answers>
```

**Body context:** `<Answer>` matchers, and the body they answer for.

### `<Break>`

Exit the nearest enclosing `<Loop>`. `<Break />` stops the current iteration where it is; nothing after it in that iteration runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Break />
```

### `<Case>`

Define one branch of a `<Switch>`. `<Case value="ready">…</Case>` matches with `===`; `<Case default>…</Case>` is the final fallback.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Case value={value}>…</Case>
<Case default>…</Case>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded when this case is selected.

### `<Catch>`

Handle a failure in the preceding Try body. `<Catch as="error">{error.message}</Catch>` runs after clean release; its bindings stay local. Cancellation skips this branch.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Catch as="error">…</Catch>
<Catch>…</Catch>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Binds the ordinary Error by reference in this branch.

**Body context:** Recovery content.

### `<Content>`

Render what the caller wrote inside this component. `<Content />` renders all of it; `<Content slot="footer" />` renders just the part the caller marked `slot="footer"`.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Content />
<Content slot="name" />
```

### `<Each>`

Repeat content for each item in an array. `<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>` binds each one to `item` inside.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Each in={list} let="item">…</Each>
```

**`as`:** Optional. Captures the whole rendered loop instead of emitting it.

**Body context:** Markdown rendered once per element.

### `<Else>`

The branch `<If>` takes when its condition is false. `<Else>…</Else>` is written directly inside an `<If>`, and is an error anywhere else.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Else>…</Else>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the enclosing condition does not hold.

### `<Finally>`

Finish a Try after its attempted body and recovery. `<Finally>Cleanup.</Finally>` also runs and joins on terminal Stop. Resumable Exit leaves an unentered branch pending; failed release and infrastructure failure prevent new entry.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Finally>…</Finally>
```

**Body context:** Completion content using the surrounding bindings.

### `<If>`

Expand content only when a condition is true. `<If condition={ready}>…</If>` expands its content, or the `<Else>` branch instead. The branch not taken never runs.

**Syntax:**

```md
<If condition={condition}>…</If>
```

**Body context:** The branch taken when the condition holds, up to an `<Else>`.

### `<Let>`

Bind a name for the rest of the region. `<Let as="plan">…</Let>` binds what its content rendered; `<Let as="plan" value={result} />` binds the value. `select` narrows the rendered content to one CSS selection.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Let as="name">…</Let>
<Let as="name" value={value} />
```

**`as`:** Required. The binding name the value is available under.

**Body context:** Markdown whose rendered text becomes the binding, in the paired form.

### `<Loop>`

Repeat content up to `max` times. `<Loop max={5}>…</Loop>` expands its content again and again until a `<Break>` inside it, or until `max` is reached. `max` is required.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Loop max={count}>…</Loop>
```

**Body context:** Markdown expanded once per iteration.

### `<Output>`

Restrict what a document or component renders. `<Output>…</Output>` becomes its entire output; anything outside the region is not rendered.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Output>…</Output>
```

**Body context:** The rendered output the run presents.

### `<PrintErrors>`

Convert thrown errors into output without failing. `<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>` renders any failure inside it as part of the output.

**Syntax:**

```md
<PrintErrors>…</PrintErrors>
```

**Body context:** The region whose failures are printed rather than raised.

### `<Return>`

Return a value instead of rendered markdown. `<Return value={result} />` hands the value to the caller, checked against the component's declared `returns` schema.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Return value={value} />
```

### `<Spawn>`

Run a task in parallel inside of `<All>`. Write `<Spawn>…</Spawn>` directly inside `<All>`; bindings made in its content stay with that task, and `<Return>` or `<Break>` cannot affect work outside it.

**Syntax:**

```md
<Spawn>…</Spawn>
```

### `<Switch>`
